notes:
Implemented all four services and three Jinja2 templates:

1. email_service.py — EmailService class with aiosmtplib async SMTP, Jinja2 template rendering, send_otp_email (renders otp_email.html with OTP code + expiry), send_notification (generic), MailHog dev mode (no auth on port 1025). Graceful exception handling returns bool.

2. payment_service.py — PaymentGateway ABC with abstract process_payment and refund. PaymentResult dataclass (success, transaction_id, message). MockPayment implementation generates fake txn IDs, always returns success=True.

3. storage_service.py — StorageService with async file I/O via aiofiles. save_file validates extension (.jpg/.jpeg/.png/.pdf) and size (10MB max), creates subfolders on demand, returns full path. get_file reads bytes. Custom exceptions: FileTooLargeError, InvalidExtensionError.

4. link_service.py — LinkService with HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens. Token format: base64url(json{session_id, purpose, exp}) + '.' + hmac_signature. generate_upload_link, generate_incidental_link, verify_link (returns dict or None for expired/invalid). Uses LINK_SECRET and LINK_EXPIRY_HOURS from config.

5. Templates: otp_email.html (styled OTP email with 10-min expiry), id_upload_page.html (drag-drop upload form with client-side validation), arrival_instructions.html (reservation details with Wi-Fi, lockbox, emergency contact).

6. Added aiosmtplib>=3.0.0 to requirements.txt.

7. Unit tests: 26 tests covering all services (email send/failure, payment result/ABC/mock, storage save/validate/read, link generate/verify/expired/tampered/malformed). All passing.
